title: Across the islands
description: A day on the bike between islands in Japan. Photographs from the road, with time to stop and look.

items.alt: A cyclist pauses beside a white arch bridge, with green hills beyond.
A quiet coastal road curves beside the water, with a suspension bridge in the distance.
Two orange-rimmed roadside mirrors overlook the water; the upper mirror reflects the photographer.
An orange roadside mirror reflects the photographer and a narrow road surrounded by greenery.
A small sandy beach and rocky shoreline beneath a suspension bridge.
A series of suspension bridge towers recedes across the water, framed by trees and overhead wires.
